result.instructions: Tools for Ordoro, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Ordoro data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run ordoro_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run ordoro_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run ordoro_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. ordoro_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: ordoro_list_orders
tools.title: List orders
tools.description: List orders across all sales channels, newest first by default. Filter by status (awaiting_fulfillment, shipped, cancelled, dropshipment_requested, all), free-text search, SKU, tag, warehouse, and created/updated/shipped date ranges. Returns { count, limit, offset, order: [...] } with lines, addresses, shipping_info (tracking), tags and financials. Ordoro API: GET /v3/order.

status.description: Order status filter (default: Ordoro's default view).

tag.description: Only orders with these tag names.

warehouse_id.description: Only orders assigned to these warehouse ids.

sales_channel.description: Only orders from these sales channel (cart) ids.

tools.name: ordoro_get_order
tools.title: Get an order
tools.description: Get one order by order number: status, lines (SKU, quantity, price), shipping/billing address, warehouse, shipping_info (carrier, tracking number, ship date, cost), comments, tags, financials and dropship info. Ordoro API: GET /v3/order/{order_number}.

order_number.description: The Ordoro order number, including its sales-channel prefix (for example "1-1001"), from ordoro_list_orders.

tools.name: ordoro_get_order_counts
tools.title: Get order counts by status
tools.description: Count orders per status: all, awaiting_fulfillment, shipped, unprinted_shipped, cancelled, dropshipment_requested. A quick fulfillment-backlog overview. Ordoro API: GET /v3/order/counts.

tools.name: ordoro_get_order_tracking
tools.title: Get an order's shipment tracking
tools.description: Get the shipment and tracking details of one order: carrier, shipping method, tracking number and tracking URL, ship date, estimated delivery, label cost, plus any return shipment and dropship info. Ordoro API: GET /v3/order/{order_number} (shipping_info).

order_number.description: The Ordoro order number, including its sales-channel prefix (for example "1-1001"), from ordoro_list_orders.

tools.name: ordoro_list_order_comments
tools.title: List an order's comments
tools.description: List the comments (internal notes and the order's activity log) of one order, with user and date. Paginated: returns { count, limit, offset, comment: [...] }; use offset for the next page. Ordoro API: GET /v3/order/{order_number}/comment.

order_number.description: The Ordoro order number, including its sales-channel prefix (for example "1-1001"), from ordoro_list_orders.

tools.name: ordoro_list_order_tags
tools.title: List order tags
tools.description: List the account's order tags (id, name, color). Use the id with ordoro_add_order_tag / ordoro_remove_order_tag. Ordoro API: GET /v3/order/tag.

tools.name: ordoro_list_products
tools.title: List products and inventory
tools.description: List products with inventory totals (total_on_hand, available_on_hand, total_committed, total_allocated, to_be_shipped, po_total_committed). Filter by search, active, low inventory, oversold, needs_sync, warehouse, supplier, tag, kit status and updated date. Returns { count, limit, offset, products: [...] }. Ordoro API: GET /product/.

active.description: true = active products only, false = archived only.

low_inventory_aoh.description: true = only products low on available-on-hand inventory.

to_be_shipped.description: true = only products with committed (to-be-shipped) inventory.

needs_sync.description: true = only products whose inventory needs syncing to a sales channel.

warehouse_id.description: Only products stocked in these warehouse ids.

supplier.description: Only products from these supplier ids.

tag.description: Only products with these tag names.

tools.name: ordoro_get_product
tools.title: Get a product with stock per warehouse
tools.description: Get one product by SKU: price, cost, weight and dimensions, inventory totals, stock per warehouse (on hand, available, committed, location), suppliers, kit components and sales-channel links. Ordoro API: GET /product/{sku}/.

annotations.title: Get a product with stock per warehouse

tools.name: ordoro_list_warehouses
tools.title: List warehouses
tools.description: List warehouses (ship-from locations) with id, name, address and whether each is the default. Ordoro API: GET /warehouse/.

tools.name: ordoro_list_suppliers
tools.title: List suppliers
tools.description: List suppliers and dropshippers with id, company name, address, contact email and dropship settings. Ordoro API: GET /supplier/.

tools.name: ordoro_get_supplier
tools.title: Get a supplier
tools.description: Get one supplier by id, with address, contact details and dropship/PO settings. Ordoro API: GET /supplier/{supplier_id}/.

tools.name: ordoro_list_shippers
tools.title: List shipping carrier accounts
tools.description: List the carrier accounts (shippers) connected to Ordoro: UPS, FedEx, USPS (Endicia/Pitney), DHL, Canada Post, Australia Post, Amazon, Sendle. Returns id, name, vendor, archive/created/updated dates and hidden shipping methods only (carrier credentials are never returned). Ordoro API: GET /shipper/.

tools.name: ordoro_list_purchase_orders
tools.title: List purchase orders
tools.description: List purchase orders to suppliers with status (unsent, sent, partial, received, cancelled), supplier, lines and expected delivery. Filter by status, SKU, tag, search and updated date. Ordoro API: GET /purchase_order/.

tag.description: Only POs with these tag names.

tools.name: ordoro_get_purchase_order
tools.title: Get a purchase order
tools.description: Get one purchase order by its PO id: supplier, warehouse, status, lines (SKU, quantity ordered/received, unit price), shipping/payment method and dates. Ordoro API: GET /purchase_order/{po_id}/.

po_id.description: The purchase order id (po_id, from ordoro_list_purchase_orders).

tools.name: ordoro_list_return_orders
tools.title: List return orders (RMAs)
tools.description: List return orders (RMAs) with reference id, status, original order, lines and return label info. Ordoro API: GET /v3/return_order.

tools.name: ordoro_add_order_comment
tools.title: Add a comment to an order
tools.description: WRITE: add an internal comment to an order (visible to the team in Ordoro, not sent to the customer). Each call adds a new comment. Ordoro API: POST /v3/order/{order_number}/comment.

order_number.description: The Ordoro order number, including its sales-channel prefix (for example "1-1001"), from ordoro_list_orders.

annotations.title: Add a comment to an order

tools.name: ordoro_add_order_tag
tools.title: Tag an order
tools.description: WRITE: apply an existing order tag (by id, from ordoro_list_order_tags) to an order, for example to put it on hold or route it. Returns the order's tags. Ordoro API: POST /v3/order/{order_number}/tag/{tag_id}.

order_number.description: The Ordoro order number, including its sales-channel prefix (for example "1-1001"), from ordoro_list_orders.

tools.name: ordoro_remove_order_tag
tools.title: Remove a tag from an order
tools.description: WRITE: remove a tag (by id) from an order. The tag itself stays defined. Ordoro API: DELETE /v3/order/{order_number}/tag/{tag_id}.

order_number.description: The Ordoro order number, including its sales-channel prefix (for example "1-1001"), from ordoro_list_orders.

annotations.title: Remove a tag from an order
